stem: Choose the compound interest for 2 years on ₹4000 at an annual interest increase of 5% per year.
The simple interest on a sum of money for 2 years is Rs. 160, while the compound interest is Rs. 164. Find the rate of interest?
expl: Simple Interest for 2 years = Rs.160 Compound Interest for 2 years = Rs.164 Difference = Rs. 4 i.e. interest for one year’s interest = Rs.4 Simple Interest of 1 year = = Rs. 80 Rate of interest (CompoundInterest-SimpleInterest)×100 = 4×100 = ∴ Rate of interest = 5%
